title: Can anyone look cool wearing Snap’s $2,000 glasses?
brief: Snap unveiled its Spectacles AR glasses priced at $2,195, positioning them as a 12-year development effort to bring computing into the physical world and reduce phone dependency. CEO Evan Spiegel framed the device as a way to keep users connected to their surroundings rather than staring at screens, though the glasses' visibility and mainstream appeal remain uncertain.
